question: LCM of two number is 22 times their HCF. If one of the numbers is 132 and the sum of LCM and HCF is 276, then what is the other number?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of HCF : LCM = 1 : 22

Total units = 1 + 22 = 23 units

23 units = 276 ⇒ 1 unit (HCF) = 12

LCM = 22 × 12 = 264

Other number = (LCM × HCF) ÷ Given number = (264 × 12) ÷ 132 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

LCM = 22 × HCF

LCM + HCF = 276

First number = 132

**Formula Used:**

Product of two numbers = LCM × HCF

 
 HCF (1x)
 
 LCM (22x)
 
• 
 Total Sum = 276
 132 × Other Number = HCF × LCM

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let HCF = H

⇒ LCM = 22H

⇒ H + 22H = 276

⇒ 23H = 276

⇒ H = 276 ÷ 23 = 12

⇒ LCM = 22 × 12 = 264

⇒ 132 × Other Number = 12 × 264

⇒ Other Number = (12 × 264) ÷ 132

⇒ Other Number = 12 × 2 = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

HCF and LCM Relation

For any two numbers a and b, HCF(a, b) × LCM(a, b) = a × b.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators) and LCM = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).

Co-prime Numbers

Two numbers are co-prime if their HCF is 1. In this case, their LCM is simply the product of the numbers.</p
